coordinates.origin: XY center of the square motor pattern at lowest frame-plastic datumZ0. Aircraft bounds including antenna differ from frame bounds.
coordinates.rotations: EulerXYZ degrees. Motor/prop local+Z is shaft axis. Camera local+Y is optical axis, local+Z is image up.
coordinates.source_resolution: source_ids resolve in specs/design_spec.json sources / research/dimensions.json sources or references/manifest.json ids.
coordinates.confidence_policy: Confidence describes evidence, not tolerance. uncertainty is null for published nominals without tolerances; estimated ranges describe plausible reconstruction choices. Derived placements inherit estimates and are not independently verified.
coordinates.registry_policy: Only main integrator may revise this registry after architecture handoff. Component authors reference stable scalar ids and may propose changes; no independent shared-dimension overrides.

frame_span_x.note: Frame-only nominal envelope; not full aircraft envelope.

frame_span_y.note: Frame-only nominal envelope; not full aircraft envelope.

frame_height.note: Frame-only nominal envelope; includes lowest protective feet.

duct_outer_radius.note: (82.6-65/sqrt(2))/2. Maximum circular rim envelope, not a uniform wall thickness.

duct_band_height.note: Continuous upper wall only; open bowed supports extend below it.

duct_top_z.note: Top of rim assumed to define maximum frame height at z=15.1.

duct_bottom_z.note: 15.1-3.8; bottom of continuous upper wall, not whole duct basket.

duct_wall_outer_radius.note: Estimated main vertical wall outer radius beneath projecting lip.

duct_lip_height.note: Estimated short rolled/rounded lip; outer radius must not exceed duct_outer_radius.

frame_arm_width.note: Ribbon width; four curved support arms per duct.

motor_pad_thickness.note: Pad between z=1.45 and z=2.7, excluding downward screw protectors.

motor_base_z.note: Estimated from side drawing and 12.4-mm lowered-duct illustration:15.1-12.4. Detail datum not explicit enough to call this verified.

motor_pad_outer_radius.note: Maximum rounded triangular pad radius, not motor radius.

motor_mount_hole_radius.note: Bolt-circle radius6.6/2; three equally spaced axes.

frame_mount_top_z.note: Estimated flat top of four cardinal frame bosses.

frame_mount_pitch.note: Adjacent-hole side length of rotated mounting square.

motor_body_height.note: Mounting base to top shoulder, excludes upper shaft.

motor_wire_length.note: Published loose wire length with connector; routing model may be simplified.

prop_swept_radius.note: 31/2. Every blade vertex and modifier result must stay within this rotor radius.

prop_hub_radius.note: Visual estimate revised centrally from2.2 to2.4mm after independent review PR-02. Within original1.9–2.5mm estimate interval. No published hub OD exists.

prop_hub_bottom_z.note: Hub is seated0.1 above motor shoulder;0.1 is visual assembly assumption.

prop_hub_top_z.note: prop_hub_bottom_z+3.3. Nominally coincides with shaft tip.

prop_blade_reference_z.note: Blade airfoil midline reference; twist changes local Z.

prop_blade_min_z.note: Target blade envelope, excluding hub; visual estimate.

prop_blade_max_z.note: Target blade envelope, excluding hub; visual estimate.

prop_nominal_pitch.note: 0.7inch*25.4mm/inch. Does not uniquely establish blade airfoil, camber or twist.

fc_mount_pitch.note: Preserve published26mm even though frame is25.5mm.

fc_mount_cardinal_offset.note: 26/sqrt(2). Three nominal board lug centers; front omitted.

fc_grommet_radial_deflection.note: Nominal board lug radius minus frame screw radius. Compliance is a modelling inference, not a manufacturer tolerance.

fc_body_side.note: Central refinement approved from manufacturer top-diagram straight-edge spacing normalized by verified26mm lug pitch; two estimates26.33/26.38mm. Photographic estimate, no calibrated scan. See reports/refinement_pcb_dimension_check.md.

fc_body_corner_radius.note: fc_body_side/sqrt(2), hypothetical diamond tip before corner clipping; do not use for lug centres.

fc_front_clip_y.note: Estimated front substrate truncation from same normalized manufacturer photo; no front lug.

fc_lug_outer_radius.note: Circular rear/left/right lug envelope centered on nominal26mm board axes.

fc_lug_hole_radius.note: Estimated board hole around compliant grommet; not screw radius.

fc_pcb_bottom_z.note: Estimated PCB bottom slightly below rim top; exposed board above frame.

fc_component_top_z.note: Estimated upper electronic component/connector envelope; not universal package height.

fc_component_bottom_z.note: Estimated underside package envelope, clear of battery upper face.

grommet_bottom_z.note: Touches frame boss; surrounds board at mid groove.

grommet_top_z.note: Estimated top flange and canopy-foot support plane.

canopy_mount_z.note: All four canopy feet share assembly screw plane; front foot uses no PCB lug.

canopy_strap_width.note: Slender lateral legs and rear arch rails; broad collar and perforated tabs differ.

canopy_arch_peak_z.note: Estimated peak above17.2mm screw plane; rise22.2mm /36.06mm span=0.616.

canopy_half_width.note: Informational half-envelope of authored formed shell including side feet, rounded from20.229862mm. Corrected from19.0mm; foot transform axes unchanged. Photographic surface estimate, not a measured product dimension.

camera_pcb_height.note: Includes lower tab; broad rectangle is permissible prototype only.

camera_pcb_thickness.note: No published PCB thickness found; visual estimate.

camera_depth.note: Measured along optical axis from PCB plane to front lens plane.

camera_tilt_deg.note: Chosen documented25deg setting; actual stock photo setting is not verified.

camera_front_center_y.note: Front lens plane center; estimated installed position.

camera_front_center_z.note: Lens rise14.3mm /36.06mm screw span=0.397; matches photographic ratio within estimated uncertainty.

camera_pcb_center_y.note: camera_front_center_y-camera_depth*cos25; follows exact chosen tilt, estimated front placement.

camera_body_center_y.note: Midpoint of camera axial depth, not center of mass.

camera_body_center_z.note: Midpoint of camera axial depth, not center of mass.

canopy_collar_axial_inset.note: Camera collar plane sits2mm behind front lens plane.

camera_clamp_radial_clearance.note: (10.2-10)/2; undeformed nominal clearance, not clamping tolerance.

antenna_base_y.note: Thick heatshrink base, behind camera PCB.

antenna_tip_y.note: Rearward-sloping tube endpoint, not craft rear bound.

antenna_tip_z.note: Unverified antenna height; use as visual silhouette estimate.

antenna_feed_radius.note: Flexible feed cable visible below antenna.

battery_slot_floor_z.note: Inside lower face of cradle; low exterior ribs may extend toz0.

battery_slot_ceiling_z.note: battery_slot_floor_z+6.2; exact nominal opening, estimated vertical placement.

battery_cradle_wall_thickness.note: Estimated PP cradle side and upper/lower band thickness.

battery_cradle_loop_y.note: Two support loops centered at y=+/-7.2.

battery_cradle_loop_width.note: Loop band width measured along aircraftY.

battery_length.note: Optional280mAh body including main cap; projecting BT2.0 nose excluded.

battery_center_y.note: Optional pack centered longitudinally; actual insertion depth varies.

fc_side_rear_clip_radius.note: Absolute left/right/back substrate truncation before circular lug. Kept inside nearest hole edge16.8348mm; photographic estimate.

fc_side_clip_half_width.note: fc_body_corner_radius minus fc_side_rear_clip_radius. Shared half-width at clipped diamond edge.

fc_front_clip_half_width.note: fc_body_corner_radius minus fc_front_clip_y. Shared half-width at clipped diamond edge.

front_left.note: Handedness convention is modelling assignment; opposite corners match. No flight-controller motor numbering inferred.

front_right.note: Handedness convention is modelling assignment; opposite corners match. No flight-controller motor numbering inferred.

rear_left.note: Handedness convention is modelling assignment; opposite corners match. No flight-controller motor numbering inferred.

rear_right.note: Handedness convention is modelling assignment; opposite corners match. No flight-controller motor numbering inferred.

camera_front.note: Local+Y is optical axis. Local+Z is camera up. Camera front plane is localXZ.

camera_pcb.note: PCB nominal front reference plane at this center. Lens front is15mm along normal_optical.

battery.note: Long axisY, connector at rear-Y. Optional separate removable assembly.

fc_pcb.note: Central body photographic estimate26.4mm before corner clipping; nominal lug locations already expressed in world axes. See refinement dimensional audit.

canopy_paths.note: Representative installed strap centerlines for shared assembly; component agents may refine local curvature within uncertainty but may not move endpoints or enclosing peak without integration approval.
canopy_paths.rear_arch_openings: Two slender rails with cross bridges retain large real openings; do not fill the arch path with an opaque broad sheet.

motor_mount_local_holes.note: Local pad axes; one representative120deg pattern. Rotate entire pad locally to match traced arm arrangement; do not alter bolt circle.

constraints.note: CAD verification tolerance only; no manufacturer tolerance is known. Tiny screw hardware is not frame plastic.

unresolved.note: 12.4mm lowered duct dimension is visually compatible with motor mounting pad below top but datum is not explicit. motor_base_z2.7 remains estimated; frame15.1 and ring3.8 remain exact published nominals.
Canopy peak and antenna tip are unverified. Estimated tip centerz54 plus sleeve radius is not published overall aircraft height.
